name: x402-scraper-engine
title: x402 Multi-Tier Agent Intelligence & Scraper Suite
description: Production HTTP 402 Agent Intelligence Suite: Scraper ($0.005), Edge LLM Digest ($0.025), Security Audit ($0.080), Deep Search ($0.050), and Twitter/X Intelligence ($0.050) on Base L2.

tools.name: clean_web_scrape
tools.description: Scrapes any public webpage and returns clean, sanitized, token-efficient Markdown for LLM ingestion. Automatically handles HTTP 402 microtransactions (0.005 USDC on Base).

url.description: The target webpage URL to scrape.

tools.name: synthesize_web_digest
tools.description: Scrapes target webpage and executes Edge LLM (Llama 3) context synthesis to extract executive summary, key takeaways, and structured entities (0.025 USDC on Base).

focus.description: Optional focus area or specific query for the synthesis.

tools.name: audit_web_signal
tools.description: Performs security, credibility, and phishing risk analysis for any website or smart contract landing page. Returns credibility score (0-100) and risk signals (0.080 USDC on Base).

url.description: The webpage URL to audit for security signals.

contract_address.description: Optional 0x EVM smart contract address to verify alongside the web page.

tools.name: clean_web_search
tools.description: Performs deep web research across multiple sources, extracting clean Markdown summaries from top results. Automatically handles HTTP 402 microtransactions (0.05 USDC on Base).

limit.description: Max number of top results to scrape (default: 3).

tools.name: twitter_search
tools.description: Searches public tweets, cashtags ($BTC, $BASE), and sentiment across Twitter/X without the $100/mo API fee. Automatically handles HTTP 402 microtransactions (0.05 USDC on Base).

query.description: Twitter search query or cashtag (e.g. '$BASE autonomous agents').

tools.name: twitter_profile_lookup
tools.description: Extracts public Twitter/X profile bio and recent tweets for any username without the $100/mo API fee. Automatically handles HTTP 402 microtransactions (0.03 USDC on Base).
